purpose: Independently compare physical BLOCK_HEADER body handle references, roles, and exact bit spans against the production reader on hash-bound AC1015 and AC1018 DWGs.

normativeSource.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

roles.ownedEntity: hard owner (code 3), repeats Owned Object Count times in R2004+
roles.insert: soft pointer (code 4), count from terminated RC sequence in R2000+

samples.provenanceLimit: Tracked ACadSharp sample; this receipt does not certify which AutoCAD release authored it.
Tracked ACadSharp sample; this receipt does not certify which AutoCAD release authored it.

independentPeer.projectionMethod: For each selected BLOCK_HEADER object, read the peer-decoded H role, target handle, and exact byte.bit cursor. H tuple payload-length plus its one-byte role/length prefix independently establishes encoded handle span size. Convert byte.bit to a bit offset and compare to production DRW_DwgSubrecordRange.

productionReader.entry: dx_iface::fileImport using the current dwgR/dwgRW reader and addBlockRecord callback

interpretation: The production parser spans and decoded references match LibreDWG 0.14 on 208 physical body-handle fields: AC1015 my_block (legacy first/last, ten INSERTs), AC1018 *Model_Space (163 owned entities), AC1018 *Paper_Space0 (two owned entities and LAYOUT), and AC1018 my_block (one owned entity, ten INSERTs). The exact source positions, H payload widths, role codes, and targets all agree. This supports these selected sample layouts and the ODA-specified role interpretation; it does not establish producer-wide prevalence, authoring-version provenance, target graph closure, strict output, native application behavior, or broader DWG support.
fixturePolicy: No DWG/DXF fixture was copied into or committed to libdxfrw. All peer outputs, logs, probe artifacts, and comparison data remain under /private/tmp.
next: Physical source-role/span evidence is complete for these selected AC1015/AC1018 objects. Keep target-graph closure and strict output qualification open; continue with the next source-ready P4/P6 gap without broadening support claims.
